newsitem.title: GERMANY: New German cargo GSA wins US Airways as client.
newsitem.headline: New German cargo GSA wins US Airways as client.

text.p: Newly-formed German cargo GSA company Airline Sales Association GmbH (ASA) said it has won US Airways as its first client.
ASA will handle sales, documentation and imports for the American carrier at its Frankfurt and Munich offices as GSA for Germany, a company statement said.
US Airways, which flies 28 times a week non-stop from Frankfurt and Munich to four U.S. cities, was previously a client of the largest German GSA, Aerotrans Luftfahrtagentur GmbH.
ASA joint managing director Lothar Schaller told Reuters that the company, founded in April, has been responsible for US Airways since mid-May.
"Our philosophy is to represent only a few airlines but with a top, reliable service standard. We want to give clients a full service," he said.

ASA is owned by Schaller, joint managing director Klaus Lederer, formerly with Expeditors International and three other employees. Nine of the company's 10 employees were formerly with Aerotrans, Schaller added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
